consequence.statement: The Envoy DaemonSet is now enabled by default, adding one Pod per Node; nodes at maximum Pod capacity will experience eviction of a single non-system critical Pod after upgrading.
consequence.remediation: Set upgradeCompatibility to 1.15 or earlier to retain the previous behavior, or set envoy.enabled explicitly to false to disable the Envoy DaemonSet and prevent the additional Pod per Node.

original.statement: The default value of Helm value envoy.enabled changed from false to null (unset), causing the Envoy DaemonSet to be enabled by default for new installations and existing clusters not explicitly configured to retain the previous behavior.

decision.reason: [ev-e24450bf8fed] says that when `envoy.enabled` is not set, the Envoy DaemonSet is now enabled by default. That adds one Pod per Node, and Nodes already at their maximum Pod count will have one non-system-critical Pod evicted after upgrading. The note says setting `upgradeCompatibility` to 1.15 or earlier keeps the previous behavior. Cilium keeps working with the new default and the eviction only affects nodes already at capacity, so behavior-change (review) fits better than a mandatory failure kind. The proposed statement and remediation match the evidence. The default change itself (false → null) is confirmed from [ev-28e0ccb5774a] and [ev-39a22d88e2f5].
